tool.name: emboss_cons
tool.description: cons calculates a consensus sequence from a multiple sequence alignment. To obtain the consensus, the sequence weights and a scoring matrix are used to calculate a score for each amino acid residue or nucleotide at each position in the alignment.

param.name: threads
param.label: Number of Threads
param.help: Number of CPU threads to use

tool.help:
**emboss_cons**
cons calculates a consensus sequence from a multiple sequence alignment. To obtain the consensus, the sequence weights and a scoring matrix are used to calculate a score for each amino acid residue or nucleotide at each position in the alignment.
